name: Douglas County, NE
findings: Douglas County has 2,511 nonprofit organizations. 1,127 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 949 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Douglas County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
